name: run_tests
description: Runs pytest on a specified test file inside the sandbox directory. Captures and returns structured outcome counts, a human-readable summary, and trimmed failure/error messages.

test_file.description: Relative path to the test file inside the sandbox (e.g., 'test_solution.py').

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds before the process is killed. Defaults to 10.

errors.description: Number of tests that errored (not failed).

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the test results (e.g., '3 passed, 1 failed').

failures.description: List of failure and error messages, one per failing test, trimmed to the test name and assertion.

timed_out.description: True if the test execution timed out, False otherwise.

error.description: Tool-level error message if something went wrong (e.g., file not found, path traversal, pytest not installed), null on success.
